column2: How do I keep my sound settings for the next cassette?
column3: “💾 Saved settings” (in Quick sound and in the Studio rack): three ready-made sets (📼 1970s cassette, 🎙 Dictaphone, 💒 1987 wedding video) and your own (“＋ Save current settings”), shared between both windows; ⋯ to rename, duplicate, export, delete; ⤒ Import.

column2: How do I clean the sound of a piece of the video montage?
column3: In the 🎬 montage, choose the sound on the timeline, 🎯 Item tab → “🔊 Sound of this piece” → “🎚️ Open in Sound studio”. Clean it, then 💾 ▾ → “Save and show this version”: it comes back clean in the montage. The other way round, Sound studio has File → “🎬 Open in the montage” to put pictures on a sound.

column2: How do I separate the sound and the picture of a video in the montage?
column3: Choose the video on the timeline, 🎯 Item tab → “🔊 Separate sound from picture” (or “🔊 Detach sound” in the bar): the sound goes onto a sound track of its own, and can be moved, cut or adjusted on its own; the picture becomes silent. To take only the sound of a video: 🎞️ Rushes tab → “＋ Sound only”, or drag the video onto a sound track.

column2: Where does a rush dragged onto the montage timeline land?
column3: On the track at the height of the mouse. On Video 1, it slots in between the pieces, where you drop it; on an overlay or sound track, at the moment where you drop it. A video keeps its sound, even as an overlay.

column2: How do I rename a rush in the montage?
column3: 🎞️ Rushes tab: ✎ under the rush. The new name shows on the timeline and in the saved project.

column2: What is the 🎞️ Rushes tab of the montage for?
column3: These are the videos, photos and sounds of the project. “⤒ Import” (several files at once) or “🗂 From the database”: they wait there, with their length, without going onto the timeline straight away. Drag a rush onto a track (video, overlay, sound) where you want it, or use “＋ Add after”, “＋ Overlay”, “＋ Sound”. The blue number says how many times it is on the timeline; ✕ removes an unused rush.

column2: How do I set up the video montage (layout, buttons, export)?
column3: Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound”: the settings panel on the right or the left, the height of the picture and tracks, the help, the colour of the blocks on the timeline (main video, overlays, texts, sounds); the default export (MP4 or WebM, size: same as the video, 4K, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p; quality; frames per second; sound); the buttons and options of each editor (montage, retouching, sound), ticked or not and ordered; full screen on opening. When you save a video, you can still change the size, quality and frames per second.

column2: What is the “Notes” tab for and how do I show it?
column3: A note is a page on a subject: “Poland before the Napoleonic wars”, a place, a trade, a custom… The tab is hidden at first: Settings → Appearance → “Main menu order”, tick “Notes”. “＋ New note”: a title, an icon, and a starting point (History topic, A place, A trade or an empty note).

column2: What can I put in a note?
column3: “＋ Block”: 📝 a text (# title, ## subtitle, - list, **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, [link](https://…), > quote), 🖼️ images and documents (from the computer or already in the app; as a mosaic, large or as a banner), 👥 people from the database, 📅 a timeline of dates, ❝ a quote and its source, 🔗 links, ➖ a subheading, 📺 a screen of the app (map, tree, list, My lists, statistic, a person’s record, village…) and 📊 a widget or chart of your own. “✏️ Arrange”: order with ↑ ↓, choose the width (¼ to full width), duplicate, delete; ✎ on a block to edit it; a colour per block or for the note. “🖨 Print” turns it into a clean page.

column2: How many tracks can a montage have? How do I add or delete them?
column3: As many as you like, of video, text and sound. Under the timeline: “＋ Video track”, “＋ Text track”, “＋ Sound track”. Adding an overlay, a text or a sound at the same moment as another creates an extra track on its own. To the left of each track: 👁 hide it (neither seen nor heard), ↑ ↓ move it (a higher video track goes in front), 🗑 delete it (straight away, with its items: “↶ Undo” in the message at the bottom brings it back, like ⌘Z), double-click its name to rename it. Drag an item from one track to another of the same kind, or choose its track in the “🎯 Item” tab.

column2: How do I shrink and move an overlaid video or a text in the montage?
column3: On the picture: click the overlay (Video 2 track) or the text, then drag it; pull the small square in the bottom right corner to make it bigger or smaller. The exact settings (width, position, size) are also in the “🎯 Item” tab.

column2: How do I zoom with the keyboard?
column3: ⌘ + and ⌘ −, ⌘ 0 to go back: in the montage this zooms the timeline; in “Edit the sound”, the waveform; in Retouch, the photo. Elsewhere, the whole page of the app gets bigger or smaller.

column2: How do I put retouching, sound or the montage in full screen?
column3: The ⛶ button at the top right of the window (as for the boards); it is kept for next time. Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound” also lets you choose full screen on opening.

column2: How do I order or hide the buttons of Retouch, sound or the montage?
column3: In the window, “⚙️ Customise”: tick what is shown and order with ↑ ↓ (or by dragging ⠿) the tools, options, settings, playback buttons… Kept for next time; “↺ Reset to default” goes back to the original buttons.

column2: How do I put a photo in a video montage?
column3: “＋ Video / photo after” adds a video or photo (from the database or the computer) to the Video 1 track; “＋ Overlay” puts it in a corner. A photo stays 5 s on screen at first: “Duration on screen” in the Item tab.

column2: How do I move a montage item to another track, or remove it?
column3: Drag it onto a track of the same kind: a video or photo goes from the Video 1 track to an overlay track (and back), a text onto another text track, a sound onto another sound track. ⌫ (Backspace) or Delete removes the chosen item, B cuts it at the playhead.

column2: How do I animate a video or photo (keyframes) in the montage?
column3: Choose the item, 🎯 Item tab → “🎛️ Picture settings” (as in Final Cut): Compositing (opacity, blend mode), Transform (position, rotation, scale, X and Y scale, anchor), Crop, Distort, Spatial conform. Place the playhead, click ◇: a keyframe; go further, change the value: a second one. Between the two, the value changes smoothly (or evenly). ◀ ◆ and ◆ ▶ jump from one keyframe to the next.

column2: How do I keep several montage layouts or several sets of buttons?
column3: Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound”: “💾 Saved settings” for the montage layout and for the buttons of each editor. Give a name, apply, delete, export or import a .json file.

column2: What tools does Retouch have (Photoshop style)?
column3: A menu at the top (File, Edit, Image, Layer, Select, Filter, View) and a column of tools to the right of the photo: ➤ move, ⬚ ◯ selections, ➰ lasso, ✒︎ pen, 🪄 automatic selection, ⌗ crop and straighten, 🩹 healing, 🧬 clone stamp, 🖌 brush, ⬜ shapes, T text, ✋ hand, 🔍 zoom. The photo itself is a layer (visibility, opacity, mask). The original is never changed.

column2: How do I select part of a photo in Retouch?
column3: Tools ⬚ (rectangle), ◯ (oval), ➰ (freehand lasso), ✒︎ (pen: point by point, Enter or double-click to close) or 🪄 (click a colour: neighbouring points of a similar shade; set the tolerance). ⇧ adds, ⌥ removes. Select menu: all, none, invert, feather, expand, contract. The selection can then go onto a layer (⌘J), be filled, erased (⌫: transparent), used as a mask or for cropping.

column2: How do I save a retouch to continue it later?
column3: In Retouch: “💾 Save the project” (bottom left, ⌘S, or File → Save the project; ⇧⌘S for a copy under another name). Everything is kept: corrections, settings, filters, cropping, layers, groups, adjustment layers, masks and selection. To pick it up again: “📂 Projects…” at the bottom of Retouch, or Lists → Media → “Retouch” → “📂 Projects”. The buttons “Save and show this version”, “Save without showing it” and “Separate copy” make the final image.

column2: How do I get more room for the photo in Retouch?
column3: The ⇥ button at the top right of the panel (Settings, Filters, Layers, History) folds it; ⇤ opens it again (also the Tab key, or View → Fold / open the panel). This is kept for next time. You can also widen the panel by dragging its edge.

column2: Does the montage have a menu like Retouch?
column3: Yes, next to the title: File (save the project, projects, export the video), Edit (undo, redo, cut here, starts and ends here, forward, back, separate the sound, remove), Add (import rushes, a rush from the database, video or photo after, overlay, title, sound), Tracks, Playback (play, to the start, keyframes) and View (tabs, timeline zoom, full screen).

column2: How do I make the small track buttons in the montage (👁 🔓 ↑ ↓ 🗑) bigger?
column3: In the montage: View → “Track buttons: bigger” (or smaller, or starting size); it is kept straight away, with “↶ Undo” in the message. Or Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound” → 🎬 Montage layout → “Size of track buttons” (from 16 to 44 px). The column of track names widens with them.

column2: How do I change the “B = cut” key (or Space, ⌫) in the montage?
column3: In the montage: Edit → “⌨️ Montage shortcuts…” (or Settings → Keyboard shortcuts, 🎬 Video montage tab): click the command, press the key you want. If you give another key to “✂️ Cut here”, “▶ Play / pause” or “🗑 Remove the chosen item”, the original key (B, Space, ⌫) no longer does that action: it is free. The menus, tooltips and the help at the bottom show your key.

column2: In the montage, what is the difference between “💾 Save” and “⤓ Export”?
column3: “💾 Save” keeps the montage project (tracks, cuts, titles) so you can reopen it and continue later; its ▾ menu also offers “Save the project under another name…” and “Keep in media (make the video)…”. “⤓ Export ▾” makes a file (MP4, WebM, sound only MP3 or WAV, subtitles) in the common export window, with a copy in the media if you want.

column2: Can I use my computer’s fonts for the montage titles?
column3: Yes: choose the title, 🎯 Item tab → “Font”: the common font list opens (search, recent, fonts of the app and of the computer; fonts already used in this film come first). If the browser asks, “🔓 See all the computer’s fonts”. The font is also used in the exported video; on another computer that does not have it, a similar font replaces it.
